# Vendored plugin base styles

Copy of [`cyfer-plugins/styles/plugin-base.css`](https://github.com/Samhij/cyfer-plugins/blob/main/styles/plugin-base.css)
(authoring source of truth). The same CSS is embedded into
`lib/plugins/base-styles.ts` for iframe injection.

Refresh from a sibling checkout (or GitHub):

```bash
npm run sync:plugin-styles
```

Do not edit the CSS here by hand — change it upstream in `cyfer-plugins`, then sync.
